segments.sn11.10:1.2: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sambahulā isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā samuddatīre paṇṇakuṭīsu sammanti.
segments.sn11.10:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena devāsurasaṅgāmo samupabyūḷho ahosi.
segments.sn11.10:1.4: Atha kho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ isīnaṃ sīlavantānaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.sn11.10:1.7: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ sambaraṃ asurindaṃ upasaṅkamitvā abhayadakkhiṇaṃ yāceyyāmā’”ti.
segments.sn11.10:1.8: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evameva – samuddatīre paṇṇakuṭīsu antarahitā sambarassa asurindassa sammukhe pāturahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.10:1.9: Atha kho, bhikkhave, te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā sambaraṃ asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu –
segments.sn11.10:2.3: Kāmaṃkaro hi te dātuṃ, bhayassa abhayassa vā”ti.
segments.sn11.10:4.3: Paṭiggaṇhāma te etaṃ, akkhayaṃ hotu te bhayaṃ.
segments.sn11.10:5.5: Pavuttaṃ tāta te bījaṃ, phalaṃ paccanubhossasī”ti.
segments.sn11.10:6.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā sambaraṃ asurindaṃ abhisapitvā – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evameva – sambarassa asurindassa sammukhe antarahitā samuddatīre paṇṇakuṭīsu pāturahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.10:6.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sambaro asurindo tehi isīhi sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi abhisapito rattiyā sudaṃ tikkhattuṃ ubbijjī”ti.

lines: Dasame samuddatīre paṇṇakuṭīsūti cakkavāḷamahāsamuddapiṭṭhiyaṃ rajatapaṭṭavaṇṇe vālukapuḷine vuttappakārāsu paṇṇasālāsu vasanti.
Asurānaṃ na sabbakālaṃ jayo hoti, bahuvāre parājayova hoti.
Te devehi parājitā palāyantā isīnaṃ assamapadena gacchantā “sakko imehi saddhiṃ mantetvā amhe nāseti, gaṇhatha puttahatāya putte”ti kupitā assamapade pānīyaghaṭacaṅkamanasālādīni viddhaṃsenti.
Isayo araññato phalāphalaṃ ādāya āgatā naṃ disvā puna dukkhena paṭipākatikaṃ karonti.
Tasmā “idāni tesaṃ saṅgāmo paccupaṭṭhito”ti sutvā evaṃ cintayiṃsu.
Bhayassa abhayassa vāti bhayaṃ vā abhayaṃ vā.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – sace tvaṃ abhayaṃ dātukāmo, abhayaṃ dātuṃ pahosi.

Tikkhattuṃ ubbijjīti sāyamāsabhattaṃ bhuñjitvā sayanaṃ abhiruyha nipanno niddāya okkantamattāya samantā ṭhatvā sattisatena pahaṭo viya viravanto uṭṭhahati, dasayojanasahassaṃ asurabhavanaṃ “kimidan”ti saṅkhobhaṃ āpajjati.
Iti asurānaṃ “mā bhāyi, mahārājā”ti taṃ assāsentānaṃyeva aruṇaṃ uggacchati.
Evamassa tato paṭṭhāya gelaññajātaṃ cittaṃ vepati.
Te pana duṭṭhajjhāsayā viruddhā hontīti āha “duṭṭhānaṃ viruddhānan”ti.
